problem: A refused snapshot write can cause the current-page SaveStore reader to return an older valid backend snapshot instead of its newly written memory snapshot.
expected: When persistent writes are denied, current memory should remain authoritative for the current page.
observed: A valid prior backend snapshot had hints=0.
The current snapshot with hints=7 was passed to SaveStore.write while setItem threw.
unknown: Whether an affected browser reports write denial persistently or intermittently.
operation: Synthetic localStorage backend returning a valid older snapshot and throwing on setItem
provenance: Actual independent module execution with synthetic denied-write backend; no production browser or player data
